messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we need an erratum publish for the docs site. Found a broken JS snippet in the Streaming API example that causes an infinite loop in current guides. I opened a hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4872 :warning:
kevin: Ugh. Do we have a repro and timeline? Can we gate this behind a small canary rollout? :eyes:
docs-bot: PR #4872 opened by maria — CI: tests passed, lint failing (minor). Staging build queued (build-2026-03-15-18).
maria: Repro steps: paste the snippet into a node REPL with streaming enabled. The issue is the sample uses `for await` incorrectly. Minimal fix in PR replaces `for await (const chunk of stream)` with `for await (const chunk of stream.chunks())`.
ashley: FYI this also affects the TypeScript snippet in /guides/streaming. I pushed a small patch to the PR to fix typings and removed the misleading comment about `autoFlush`.
samir: I can draft the publish blurb and erratum text. Suggest wording: "Fix: correct streaming example to avoid infinite loop in Node runtime; updated TS/JS snippets and added note about stream buffer handling." Want it short for the release banner.
leo: I can run the staged publish once we greenlight. Proposed plan: (1) merge PR, (2) canary to staging for 30m, (3) run quick smoke (copy snippet into a fresh Node14/18 container), (4) push to prod with a one-line flag to avoid CDN cache issues.
kevin: Sounds good. Any user-facing impact? Do we need to send a customer ping or add a "known issue" note?
maria: Not widespread but could break new integrations. Recommend a short "erratum" entry under the v0.9.7 changelog + a small banner on the streaming guide page for 48h. Samir — can you include a short workaround for users who hit it before we publish?
samir: Yep. Workaround: replace the loop with `stream.readableStreamDefaultReader()` pattern OR use `stream.chunks()` as in the PR. I'll add both options and a one-line code comment.
kevin: One more ask — can we include a rollback command if publish misbehaves?
leo: Rollback plan: rollback CDN edge via `bin/content rollback --tag v0.9.7-erratum` and revert the merge commit with `git revert -m 1 <merge_sha>` then re-run publish. I will paste exact commands in the ops checklist before executing.
docs-bot: Staging build completed: build-2026-03-15-18 — smoke tests: 12/12 passed.
maria: OK merging PR now after a squash and adding a short comment for the TS snippet. I'll tag it `hotfix/docs/streaming-snippet-4872` before merge.
ashley: Added the comment + removed the confusing `autoFlush` note. :thumbsup:
kevin: Can we schedule the staging canary at 20:30 UTC? That gives support an hour to prep.
leo: 20:30 UTC works. I'll be standing by.
samir: Drafted erratum blurb — dropping into the PR description and the release notes draft. Also adding a two-line workaround section.
maria: Thanks everyone. After the canary, if smoke is clean, we'll push to prod and post an update in #general and pin the erratum to the v0.9.7 changelog.
leo: After prod push I'll run the CDN purge: `bin/content purge --paths "/guides/streaming*" --async` and share the purge ID.
kevin: I'll prepare the support canned response for incoming tickets and link to the workaround.
docs-bot: Merge of PR #4872 scheduled by maria. Automated checks required: lint fix in CI (one whitespace rule).
maria: I'll fix lint quickly in the same branch and force-push. Expect merge in ~10m.
samir: I'll wait to finalize the release blurb after merge to include the exact commit sha.
leo: Standing by at 20:20 UTC. :rocket:
